Centralize customers, track vendors, and build stronger client relationships directly in a servicesDataSalesforce-powered platform.

financialControl.title: Construction-Focused CRM, Built on Salesforce to Streamline Lead and Prospect Management
financialControl.description: A smarter way to manage relationships, opportunities, and project communication.
features: BuilderTek CRM Management extends Salesforce’s native CRM capabilities with construction-specific workflows. Connects leads, accounts, opportunities, and contacts directly to projects, quotes, contracts, and financial data.
Give teams complete visibility into every relationship while reducing manual data entry and disconnected communication.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about BuilderTek RFQ.

items.question: How is BuilderTek CRM different from standard Salesforce CRM?
items.answer: BuilderTek enhances Salesforce CRM with construction-specific workflows and direct links to projects, budgets, and contracts.

items.question: Can sales and project teams use the CRM together?
items.answer: BuilderTek CRM is designed for shared visibility across sales, operations, and project teams.

items.question: Does BuilderTek CRM support vendor and subcontractor management?
items.answer: Yes. Vendors and subcontractors are managed as accounts and contacts connected directly to projects.

items.question: Can emails and communication be tracked in BuilderTek CRM?
items.answer: Yes. Emails, notes, tasks, and follow-ups are logged directly in Salesforce for a complete history.
